Nina learned a lot about art. They took many photos at the subway station. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, the warranty runs for two years.
Nina is reading a book about art. Nina and Ben had great fun there. Both of them like soup and coffee. In fact, glass skyscrapers line the new district.
